job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Trust (ML/Algo)
job.pay_full: $179,000 – $210,000 a year base pay range; the role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits

details.about: Airbnb has grown from one San Francisco home in 2007 to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals. The Trust Integrity Data Science team keeps content on Airbnb (listings, profiles, messages and other user-generated content) accurate, authentic and in line with its policies, working with product, engineering, policy and operations on AI-driven content understanding, human-in-the-loop workflows and defences against new content risks.
duties: Build and deploy production machine learning systems for trust integrity: feature engineering, model development and evaluation, thresholding, error analysis and full model lifecycle, including NLP and LLM-based models
Work with inference data scientists on rigorous quantitative analyses, using causal inference to judge impact and find ways to improve content quality and trust
Present clear research findings with strong data visualizations to align product, engineering and operations partners
Think strategically about scaling data science in the domain and contribute to its long-term vision
needs: 5+ years of industry experience in a quantitative analysis role with a Master's in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, etc.), or a PhD in a relevant field
Hands-on experience building, evaluating and deploying NLP and LLM-based solutions
Strong Python and SQL, with experience in TensorFlow, PyTorch, Spark, Airflow and a data warehouse
Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, plus strong project management and collaboration
nice: Publications or presentations at recognized journals or conferences
details.benefits: Base pay range $179,000 – $210,000 a year; actual pay depends on training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits.
notes: US remote eligible; you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity (some states are excluded)
May include occasional work at an Airbnb office or offsites
Airbnb will never ask candidates to pay a fee or share bank details while interviewing
